recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中有數顆小型成熟淋巴球，核染色質緻密、胞質極少，並有多個被推破、呈扁平淡紫色不規則形的「塗抹細胞」（smudge cells，箭頭），此組合是 CLL 的典型血片表現；此視野血小板稀少。
features: Several small mature lymphocytes with round nuclei, dense clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm
Multiple smudge (basket) cells: flattened, disrupted lilac nuclear material with frayed, irregular borders (arrows)
Very few platelets in the field
Red cells largely normocytic and normochromic without significant poikilocytosis
No prolymphocytes or blasts evident in this field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an increase in small, mature-appearing lymphocytes with dense clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm, accompanied by numerous smudge cells representing fragile lymphocytes disrupted during smear preparation. Platelets appear decreased in this field, and red cells are unremarkable. No prolymphocytes are seen here. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia; flow cytometry (CD5+, CD23+, dim CD20 and surface Ig) is required for confirmation, and thrombocytopenia should be evaluated for immune destruction versus marrow infiltration.

ddx.vs: Cells often show irregular or cleaved nuclei and smudge cells are fewer; cyclin D1-positive and CD23-negative.
Lymphocytes are polyclonal and often more pleomorphic, and numerous smudge cells are uncommon.
Platelet clumps appear as granular aggregates of discrete platelets rather than homogeneous disrupted nuclear chromatin.
Lymphocytes have polar villous cytoplasmic projections and are usually CD5-negative.
